[align=center][b]Arms and exclusive trade rights deal between The United Territories of Nordiheim and The Empire of Yulandburg[/b][/align]
[align=center][i]====================================================[/i][/align]

[align=center][i][u]With this deal the two nations of Nordiheim and Yulandburg agree to adhere to the following arms, trade rights and diplomatic agreements:[/u][/i][/align]

[align=center][b][i][u]Blueprint[/u][/i][/b][/align]

[u][b]1.b:[/b][/u] By doing this Nordiheim gives Yulandburg the legal permission to build, modify, use and sell units of this rifle in and from their nations military market.

[u][b]2.a:[/b][/u] Nordiheim will sell 10 units of Irond Drake 2-D to Yulandburg.

[b][u]2.b:[/u][/b] Nordiheim agrees to allow Yulandburg easy access to buy aditional Iron Drake 2s of the "D" or "E" variants aswell as spare/replacment parts for these vehicles.

[b][u]4.c:[/u][/b] Prices can only be renegotiated outside of the quarterly basis if someting big happens to either nation or the world market if both nations come together and mutually agree to it.
